source: Climate Resilient Broadcasting Rice Growing Technique, ASPIRE/IFAD, MAFF, Feb 2018
text:
A general indicative calendar for broadcast rice in Cambodia: first plowing (initial land preparation) roughly January through April; second plowing to prepare wet soil for broadcasting around April through June; broadcasting/sowing during June through August. Harvest timing then depends on which duration group the variety belongs to: short-duration varieties are typically harvested around September to November; medium-duration varieties around November to December; long/heavy-duration (photoperiod-sensitive) varieties around December to January, since those flower on a fixed calendar date regardless of sowing time.

This calendar is a national planning guide, not a fixed rule -- actual sowing and harvest dates shift with when the rainy season actually starts and how long it lasts in a given year and location, so a farmer should adjust against locally observed rainfall rather than the calendar month alone.
